verdict.rationale: Mercury documents user-configurable background automations: categorization rules created through Command, recurring invoices sent on a chosen schedule, and continuous automatic categorization and reconciliation. However, Command is an on-demand assistant, the API and MCP layer for autonomous agents are only announced as 'soon', and Mercury itself says the product is not 'autopilot'. missing for 10: a general automation or workflow builder, autonomous agent-run recurring tasks, a shipped API/MCP for agent automation, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Use Mercury Command to bulk assign GL codes, create categorization rules, and more
